I need to verify the historical fact about who killed Lee Harvey Oswald.

Lee Harvey Oswald, the accused assassin of President John F. Kennedy, was shot and killed by Jack Ruby (born Jacob Rubenstein) on November 24, 1963, in the basement of Dallas Police Headquarters. This event was captured on live television and is one of the most well-documented moments in history. Jack Ruby was a Dallas nightclub owner who shot Oswald while he was being transferred to the county jail.

This is an extremely well-established historical fact with extensive documentation, eyewitness accounts, video footage, and legal records.

Answer: Jack Ruby
